svg.title: Filters that take several values at once — SoftTrack web design mockup (#260)
svg.desc: A filter takes one status, one priority, one assignee, one label and one type, so the board can show Mei’s tickets or Daniel’s and not both. Each filter takes a list: values inside a filter are alternatives, different filters narrow each other, labels can be any or all, and one switch per filter excludes.
